DISAPPOINTED
Dec 2024 • Couples
Had high hopes for this place as lots of locals in there. Waited so long for food & drinks. Drinks never even came then when asked they brought the wrong drinks. Food came out sporadically , we had the curries for ages & had to ask for the rice , which then came out lukewarm- if that. 
2/3 curries were bland and tasteless & not particularly hot in temperature. The bill was wrong when it arrived. Rubbish service could easily be forgiven if the food was decent but it wasn’t. Was quite expensive really especially for the surroundings etc .. looked more like a greasy spoon- again ,nothing wrong with that if the food good. I would avoid really.
